label: Bible Study
prompt: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath _____, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verse: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
note: An invitation to come home — the God who tore is the God who heals.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For thou art my _____, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
verse: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
note: From David's song after deliverance from Saul: God is his lamp, lighting up the dark.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of _____, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verse: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
note: Lydia, a seller of purple from Thyatira, opened her heart to Paul's message — and then her home (Acts 16:15).

label: Deep Water
prompt: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the _____ of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verse: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
note: Leave the field's edges for the poor — the very law that let Ruth glean in Boaz's field.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For whom the Lord loveth he _____, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verse: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
note: Hebrews quotes Proverbs 3:12: whom the Lord loveth he 'chasteneth' — discipline as proof you're a true son.
